correctness.rationale: For G=V⋊H, |H| prime to p, the averaging idempotent splits V=F⊕U with F=V^H and U=[V,H]. A normal supplement N of a p-subgroup W forces H<=N then U<=N, so W∩U is H-stable; conversely if K=W∩U is stable choose F-complement L of projection(W) and N=(U⊕L)⋊H, obtaining WN=G and W∩N=K<=Core_G W. In a complete flag each step changes either intersection with U or projection to F, giving invariant U-flags and unconstrained F-flags. Maschke implies invariant U full flags exist iff every irreducible constituent is one-dimensional; count shuffles of eigenspace flags u!/∏mχ! ∏Φ_p(mχ). For fixed component flags and interleaving, projection steps at intersection rank a have p^(u−a) graph-map extensions, whose Gaussian binomial sum [n choose u]_p multiplies Φ_p(f), giving the theorem and ratio. All flags c-normal iff every H-matrix scalar on U. Independent group multiplication, normal-subgroup enumeration for F3^2⋊C2 diag(-1,1) matched the criterion for every one of six V-subspaces (14 group subgroups, six normal); independent full-flag enumeration for the Klein action on F3^3 with distinct moving characters and one fixed coordinate gave exactly 26/52. No enumeration is used in place of the all-group proof.
residual_risks: The proof depends on correct interpretation of ambient c-normal W and uses normal supplement rather than external AC-normality; all hypotheses p∤|H| and elementary-abelian V are essential.
